packages.name: Cell Biology
packages.description: A planned path through cell structure, membranes, metabolism, division, and experimental evidence.

packages.name: Genetics & Inheritance
packages.description: A future sequence connecting Mendelian models, chromosomes, molecular genetics, and population variation.

packages.name: Human Physiology
packages.description: A systems-level tour of circulation, respiration, digestion, regulation, and physiological tradeoffs.

packages.name: Atomic Structure
packages.description: A planned progression from evidence for atoms to electron structure, periodicity, and chemical behavior.

packages.name: Chemical Reactions
packages.description: A future pack on equations, stoichiometry, energy change, reaction rates, and laboratory reasoning.

packages.name: Acids, Bases & Equilibria
packages.description: A planned quantitative treatment of pH, buffers, titration, equilibrium, and competing chemical models.

packages.name: Classical Mechanics
packages.description: A future path from motion graphs and vectors to forces, energy, momentum, and model limitations.

packages.name: Electricity & Circuits
packages.description: A planned inquiry-driven pack covering charge, fields, potential, circuit models, and measurement.

packages.name: Waves, Optics & Sound
packages.description: A future curriculum linking oscillations, wave representations, interference, imaging, and acoustics.

packages.name: Programming Foundations
packages.description: A language-neutral introduction to state, control flow, functions, debugging, and program design.

packages.name: Data Structures
packages.description: A planned visual course on arrays, lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, and design tradeoffs.

packages.name: Algorithms & Complexity
packages.description: A future path through algorithm design, correctness arguments, runtime growth, and practical limits.

packages.name: Ancient Civilizations
packages.description: A comparative history of early states, trade networks, belief systems, evidence, and historical debate.

packages.name: Industrial Revolution
packages.description: A planned investigation of industrialization, labor, technology, empire, urban change, and inequality.

packages.name: The Twentieth-Century World
packages.description: A future evidence-led sequence on world wars, decolonization, ideology, globalization, and memory.

packages.name: Microeconomics
packages.description: A planned course on incentives, markets, elasticity, strategic behavior, externalities, and welfare.

packages.name: Macroeconomics
packages.description: A future path through national accounts, inflation, unemployment, growth, policy, and open economies.

packages.name: Personal Finance
packages.description: A planned practical pack on budgeting, credit, compound growth, risk, insurance, and investing claims.

packages.name: Academic Writing
packages.description: A future workshop on claims, structure, evidence, revision, citation, and writing for real readers.

packages.name: Literary Analysis
packages.description: A planned close-reading sequence connecting form, voice, context, interpretation, and critical disagreement.

packages.name: Probability
packages.description: A future course moving from sample spaces and conditional probability to simulation and Bayesian updating.

packages.name: Data Visualization
packages.description: A planned studio for choosing encodings, spotting misleading graphics, and communicating uncertainty clearly.

packages.name: Geology & Earth History
packages.description: A future evidence-based path through rocks, plate tectonics, deep time, resources, and landscape change.

packages.name: Weather & Climate
packages.description: A planned quantitative course on atmosphere, forecasting, climate systems, evidence, and uncertainty.

packages.name: Logic & Argumentation
packages.description: A future practice course on validity, informal fallacies, charitable reconstruction, and disciplined disagreement.
